anima.name: Anima
anima.description: Round start: gain a single-use Shinheuh combat slot if you don't already have one.

silver-dwarf.name: Silver Dwarf
silver-dwarf.description: The first time you draw a card each round, choose the card directly from your deck.

red-witch.name: Red Witch
red-witch.description: You can always see your opponent's hand and the top card of both players' decks.

hwayeomsa.name: Hwayeomsa
hwayeomsa.description: Spend 1, Free: Charge 1 Fire Charge and create Fire Core in your hand if you don't already have it.

jeonsulsa.name: Jeonsulsa
jeonsulsa.description: When I'm deployed, heal 2 HP from or summon Conduit on the enemy backline.

irregular.name: Irregular
irregular.description: Unit passives and landmarks have no effect on me.

living-ignition-weapon.name: Living Ignition Weapon
living-ignition-weapon.description: You may equip me as many times as you want with unique equipments.
